avoid: Treating D’s high benchmark score as evidence of discovery when all reported novelty metrics were zero.
Concluding that A, B, or C is mathematically unpromising from implementation failures alone.
Broadening D or E after their completed zero-novelty trials.
Using unrestricted solver calls or top-level solver calls that violate the evaluation interface.
Inferring hidden seeds, missing-pair identities, or desired group-signature combinations from these results.
generation_feedback.diagnosis: The incumbent wins because this generation produced no measured coverage gain. D and E were the only candidates to complete preliminary evaluation; both recorded 0 fresh missing pairs, 0 fresh pair hits, 0 fresh seed hits, and no discriminant improvements. D achieved strong raw scores (39200.822 screen; 52260.7105 benchmark), showing that its critical-orbit construction generated substantial valid material, but that material overlapped existing coverage. E also ran successfully but scored much lower (4011 screen; 5011 benchmark) and likewise added no novelty. A, B, and C were not evaluated: A timed out during the AI call, B during the solver call, and C violated the top-level solver-call constraint. These are operational failures, not evidence against their mathematical hypotheses. Overall, the generation favored ambitious constructions without first ensuring that each could complete a small, deterministic test.
generation_feedback.next_generation_direction: Rescue B as a deterministic micro-benchmark because its signature control is explicit and requires little solver work. Fix two or three small real biquadratic fields, enumerate bounded integer triples for the nonconstant coefficients of c, compute the four embedding contributions directly, and select the constant coefficient from the exact intervals that force each desired positivity count. Expand no more than 10 resulting octics, apply cheap squarefreeness and irreducibility filters, and give each survivor a strict verification timeout. Record completion count, runtime, realized signatures, fresh pair and seed hits, and discriminant improvements. Retire the construction if this fixed quota completes with zero novelty; do not enlarge the search beforehand.
what_worked: D’s critical-orbit specialization completed screening and benchmarking and produced the generation’s strongest raw scores.
E’s injectively indexed CRT construction avoided the previously reported duplicate-within-call failure and reached preliminary evaluation.

The candidates explored genuinely distinct structural regions: quaternion extensions, signature-controlled quadratic towers, projective mod-7 resolvents, arboreal subgroups, and locally steered CRT polynomials.
